evals.prompt: Here are notes from 6 interviews with people who moved their 3a pension to our app in the last 2 months: [notes]. Extract the jobs and forces.
evals.expected_output: A jobs report with forces of progress, solution-free job statements with circumstances and interview counts, and job stories.
expectations: Job statements contain no product or UI words
Each job shows how many of the 6 interviews support it
Forces are grouped into push, pull, anxiety and habit
No invented quotes; evidence is paraphrased from the notes
